scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:load
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:unit:backend && pnpm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.test:unit:frontend: pnpm --filter nmmcqueue-frontend exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts ../../tests/unit/frontend --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:integration:backend && pnpm run test:integration:frontend
scripts.test:integration:frontend: pnpm --filter nmmcqueue-frontend exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts ../../tests/integration/frontend --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --filter nmmcqueue-frontend exec vitest run --config vitest.frontend.temp.config.ts
